description: YOLOv8s with an extra P2 head (stride 4), COCO weights; full frames + 2x2 tiles of wide frames, 1280 px
FCOS R50-FPN, COCO weights, torchvision defaults
label assignment - centre sampling radius 2.5 strides instead of 1.5 (more positive locations)
box regression loss CIoU instead of GIoU (adds centre-distance and aspect-ratio terms)
extra high-resolution level P2 (stride 4) - FPN levels P2-P7, size ranges shifted down one level
Faster R-CNN R50-FPN, COCO weights, torchvision defaults
GIoU loss instead of smooth L1 for the second-stage box regression
RoI sampling 1024 per image with 50% positives (dense scenes have many positives)
smaller anchors (16-256 px) + 2x more RPN proposals for small, dense objects
anchors from the EDA object sizes - P3 starts at 16 px (16-406 px instead of 32-813 px)
RetinaNet R50-FPN v2, COCO weights, torchvision defaults
focal loss gamma 1.5 instead of 2 - less down-weighting of easy anchors
looser anchor assignment - positive at IoU >= 0.4, negative below 0.3
RetinaNet tuned - P3 anchors from 16 px with wider octave scales (16-645 px), focal gamma 1.5
RT-DETR R50vd (Hugging Face), COCO weights, paper defaults
500 denoising queries instead of 100 - several denoising groups even in dense frames
matching cost weights - GIoU 4 and L1 2 instead of 2 and 5 (L1 on normalised boxes barely separates small objects)
500 object queries instead of 300 - the densest frames have up to 180 objects
